initial_decision.brief_rationale: The observed risk difference is 0.20, but the completed checks verify arithmetic, not causal identification. Request archived design record R132-1 to evaluate whether the causal effect is identified.

final_decision.brief_rationale: The design record establishes randomized assignment, full compliance, positivity, consistency, and no interference, identifying the causal risk difference. The exact population risks are 24/30 = 0.8 under X=1 and 72/120 = 0.6 under X=0, giving 0.2.
